chapter: Trombone technique, plunger mute and the California years
title: Forgotten trumpet greats: Rex Stewart, Jabbo Smith and Sidney De Paris
summary: He says great players like Rex Stewart, Jabbo Smith and Sidney De Paris are forgotten, though Rex wrote and composed.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: He could play anything. He could play anything. I don't know why... This is... There's several guys that no one seems to...everyone seems to forget about. There's Rex Stewart. There's another guy that was a genius on the trumpet. He really was. I mean, I'm not taking anything away from anybody. But you know, he was just a great guy, and... Like Jabbo Smith was a great trumpet player. Like Sidney De Paris. And all those guys, you know... People seem to forget them, you know what I mean? It just that, 'Oh, well, that's another cigarette I had.' You know what I mean?
Yes. Well, that seems to have happened quite a lot in the history of this music.
Yeah. They should have a little remembrance every now and then. Somebody should give them a good mention, you know.
Yeah, Rex may be a little better remembered, because he did some writing, too, near the end of his life, when he wrote some...
Yeah! Not only was he a musician, he was a writer and everything. And a composer; he wrote some... So he was a pretty good dude.
